page.layout: One title page, all lines centred. Above the title, a faded line and mirrored text are show-through from the reverse and are left out. Below the title, a palm-tree engraving with two banner scrolls. Below the engraving, the place of printing and the printer's line.

main_text.l: Commentarius Theorico-Practicus in decem Capita Priora Epistolae D. Pauli

page.notes: The title line "JACOBI ALTING" and the lines beneath it (the author's descriptor and the Professor line) appear mirrored and upside down. They are show-through from the other side and are left out. The stamp of the Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München and the handwritten call number 220.7 / A96 / v.3 are not printed text and are left out. The engraving shows a palm tree with two banners. The lower banner reads VIRESCIT. The upper banner is partly legible as "...T PALMA", the rest unreadable because of mirroring, so it is not transcribed. The imprint year is read as MDCLXXXVI from "clɔ Iɔc LXXXVI"; the numerals are faint, so the year is marked [?]. The printer's name is partly unclear and reads as GERARDUM BORSTIUM; this is also uncertain.
